contexts.text: Spirits who supposed they were able to do all things.
The man who is alienated from good and truth intends nothing but evil, for he is not able to intend what is good.
The infernals are not able to do what is good, because it is repugnant to them.
There is in man the ability to love, although he does not exercise it...
Ability in itself is Divine. Explained.
For all ability there must be opportunity.
The Posse and Velle of God are one. Explained.
It is said they are not able, because the inward will of their mind is adverse.
When a spirit confesses that he is not able to desist from evil he is vastated until he is able... SE 1377. See SE 1794. SE 2206. DMin 4743.
They said they could not by any possibility desist...
